description: Show the best Generalist reference photo on screen in the design gallery for live comparison. Jake (voice): 'Put somewhere on the screen the actual photos you have of the Generalist one, from the top angle, the best photo that shows the design well. Because it's the same all the way down, a top angle would be best. I'd like to see that in there so we can compare it live.' Ask: in the Helping Hands design gallery/viewer, when viewing a Generalist-copy gripper (Gen 6, 7, 9, 10, 11...), show a reference photo panel on screen next to the 3D model. Default to the best top-down profile shot (cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_two_hands.png is the clearest full finger profile; _top.png is the alternative; pick whichever shows the shape best), and let him swap to the other reference photos. It must work on the phone layout too.

results.identified_issue: Photo registration: make_reference.py uses the inverse of gripper.scad px() (mm_per_px 0.2, px_pivot [337,395], axis_deg 36.5) plus the v011b right-hinge pivot X 27.672 (poses.js). It writes an affine-resampled PNG covering X -75..75, Z -45..125 mm, which gallery.js lays on the Y=0 plane facing -Y. That's why Top looks from -Y with +X right: px()'s matrix has det -1 against y-down pixels, so the photo is the -Y view in CAD coordinates even though the scad comments call +Y dorsal. Photos live under cad/mobile_gallery/reference because publish_designs.py only copies cad/mobile_gallery/**.png and .js. I didn't touch publish_designs.py because another session edited it minutes earlier. alignAll() uses the union of all visible non-photo models for a shared centre and scale (a deliberate single frame, so a far-off design like Gen 8 dominates). Top sets openness to 0 when the photo tile is visible. Tested with headless Chrome screenshots at 1500x900 and about 500px wide. Not tested: clicking on a real phone, or the flat-photo dropdown path. Pre-existing: test_gripper_poses fails for v011 (single 'Gen 11' assembly mesh, so '^Right' matches nothing).
results.summary: Gallery now has an 'Actual (Generalist)' photo tile next to Gen 9–11, plus Top/Front/Side/Iso buttons that snap every tile to the same view and scale. Top lines the models up with the photo.
results.detailed_description:
In the Generalist Gripper gallery, the first tile is now 'Actual (Generalist)'. It's the left gripper from the two-hands top-down photo, which shows the finger profile most clearly. I didn't just paste the photo in. I resampled it into the gripper's own millimetre frame (the same photo-to-mm mapping Gens 9–11 were traced from) and placed it as a flat plane in 3D, so it has the same scale and position as the models.

Bottom right there are now four buttons: Top, Front, Side, Iso. Each one snaps every tile on screen, the photo included, to one camera angle, centre and zoom, framed around all the shown models together. Top is the photo's viewpoint (fingertips up). It also slides the jaws to Closed, because the photo was traced in that pose. In the screenshot, Gens 9, 10 and 11b line up with the photo at the same size.

A dropdown on the photo tile swaps to the other reference photos (top-with-bowl, side, closed, on the robot, cup, camera, target). Those can't be aligned, so they show as flat pictures and the presets skip them. The tile hides through 'Hide…' like any generation. The phone layout uses the same single column; Actual is the top row, and you can tap it to fill the screen. Link shortcut: add ?view=top to the URL. I also fixed the label for Gen 11b, which used to read as a second 'Gen 11'.

Things to know: (1) Gen 11 (Opus) still won't open or close. It publishes as one merged mesh, and the existing pose test already fails on it; I didn't touch it. (2) The models in a preset share one frame. If you un-hide a big design (e.g. Gen 8 Grabette, which sits 320 mm to the side), everything zooms out to fit it. (3) The gallery's viewer files (gallery.js, index.html, README) were never in git, so this commit adds them too, along with about 3 MB of photo copies under cad/mobile_gallery/reference.
results.user_reply_draft: The real Generalist photo is now in the gallery as 'Actual (Generalist)', right beside Gen 9, 10 and 11. Tap Top in the bottom-right corner and every model snaps to the photo's angle at the same size, so you can compare them directly. Front, Side and Iso line everything up the same way.
